item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i bdag nyid dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyi sgrub snying gi thig le
item.coloph: ces pa'i gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i bdag nyid dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyi sgrab snying gi thig le man ngag smar byang 'di yang / sa steng gi skyes bu mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i/ gsang chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i grub thob/ dus ngan bskal khug gso ba'i rnal 'byor/ lta ba yang rtse phyin pa'i rtogs ldan/ sprul pa'i gter gshen chen klu dga' ba de nyid kyi gar rol/ sbas pa'i tshul 'chang kun dga' dbang ldan de nyid kyi bon skal 'di yang / dus dang rkyen gyis 'phro lus su song bas/ phyis su rten 'brel skabs su bab pa'i kho bo bdag nyid gsang ba'i zhing dang zhing khams bsgrod nas lha mchog rig 'dzin chen po'i mngon zhal mjal skabs/ sngon gyi 'phro lus kyi gdams pa zhus pas/ bdag la gsang ba'i gdams pa gnang zhing ma spel snying gi dkyil du sbas nas yod skabs/ gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin grags pa'i rgyal tshab/ mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal rigs bdag 'chang ba'i 7spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags dang nyi ma lhun grub sku mched zung nas rten 'brel dar dkar dri med kyis sna drangs nas bka' gsung bde chen spyi bo'i gtsug tu phebs pa dang / ma zad mkhas pa'i nor la dbang zhing gnas lnga bon gyis phyug pa'i bka' slob/ brtse gdung gcig tu 'dres pa'i grogs po tshul khrims blo gros kyis/ bder gshegs thugs rgyud bskul ba'i dri bzang / rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i glegs thag ngo mtshar mig gi dpal gter lha rdzas dar dkar gyis sna drangs nas bskul ba dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid kyi nye gnas mos pa gting nas skyes pa'i btsun pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis rgya sil gshang chung dang rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo phar phyin theg pa'i grangs ldan dang dar dkar gyis sna drangs te bskul ba la brten/ skabs su bab pa'i kho bo tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'breng 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba des/ dbal gyi phur pa nag po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas kyi mdun zhol/ bon gyi 'dus sde chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dkar chag yi ger bris pa'o/ dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
